Mg2+ ions can be introduced into NaGdF 4:Yb 3+, Er 3+ nanoparticles to enhance upconversion photoluminiscence.

the Mg2+ ions can be successfully codoped into hexagonal phase NaYF4:YbnEr3+ nanoparticles, which is helpful to enhance the UC fluorescence of the rare earth ions, and the UC luminescent intensity of the codoped MgYb3+Er3+ ions can be enhanced to the maximum by controlling the concentration of Mg ions.
the introduction of Mg2+ can effectively improve the morphology and upconversion luminescence of the hexagonal phase NaYF4:Y3+/Er3+ nanoparticles.

the synthesis of Mg2+ codoped NaG GdF4: Yb3+ Er 3+ nanoparticles with enhanced upconversion emission, which is of significance in developing the potential application of the upconversion luminescent nanomaterials in the field of bioimaging and optical amplification.
the synthesis, structure, and optical properties of NaGd0.8Yb0.1Er0.1F4: Mg2+ nanoparticles, and provides a reference for the preparation and application of other rare-earth doped nanoparticles.

the shape controllable synthesis of NaGd4F4: Yb3+ Er 3+ nanocrystal with different concentrations of Mg2+, and the results show the potential application of the codoped Mg 2+ in the upconversion nanoparticles.

the introduction of Mg2+ into NaGdF 4:Yb Er nanoparticles is a simple and effective approach to enhance the UC fluorescence intensitiy.
the introduction of Mg2+ could improve the upconversion luminescence properties and shape controllability of the rare earth doped NaGd4:Yb Er NCs.
